rule: 2 Oct decision: one PRIMARY source, typed (g1_tracker.single_primary_source); model-read, gate-verified (scripts/g1_trial_acquire.py)

model.why: AACT reports lipid outcomes, not MACE. No open full text or meta rows are supplied. EMA reports COMBO I deaths in the safety population, not MACE in the whole randomized ITT population. No eligible MACE counts or HR with two-sided 95% CI at longest follow-up are provided.

AACT provides no MACE counts or effect estimate; full text is withheld. EMA reports a treatment-emergent safety-population analysis, not a verified whole-randomized-population ITT result at longest follow-up. The meta row is REFUSED and cannot establish the trial’s own result.

model.timepoint_as_stated: from first to last injection plus 70 days (or to the first injection in the open-label extension, whichever came first)
model.why: AACT provides lipid outcomes only. Full-text CV counts cover a safety population excluding a randomized participant; equivalence to MACE is not established. No whole-randomized-population MACE HR with two-sided 95% CI is supplied. The regulatory window has no relevant result; the meta row is REFUSED.

AACT provides lipid outcomes only. Full-text CV event counts cover the safety population, excluding one randomized placebo participant; equivalence to the requested MACE composite is unspecified. No qualifying whole-randomized-population counts or HR with two-sided confidence interval are supplied. The regulatory window provides no relevant result.

AACT reports lipid outcomes only. Full-text safety denominators cover the whole randomized population. These are broader adjudicated CV-event counts, including heart-failure hospitalization and coronary revascularization, not explicitly MACE. Ascertainment is treatment-emergent rather than complete ITT follow-up; the requested HR with two-sided 95% CI is absent.

No AACT results, open full text or meta rows are supplied. The EMA window discusses pharmacokinetics, with no ODYSSEY JAPAN MACE counts or HR with 95% CI for the whole randomised intention-to-treat population at longest follow-up.

PACMAN-AMI (NCT03067844) has no posted results; full text is withheld. The other AACT record concerns NCT01507831. The EMA window reports deaths in other studies, not PACMAN-AMI MACE. No eligible whole-randomised-population counts or HR with two-sided 95% CI are supplied; no meta rows are available.

No eligible primary MACE result: AACT reports lipid outcomes; no open full text is supplied; EMA windows provide no whole-trial DESCARTES MACE result. Meta fallback is marked REFUSED and reports OR, not the requested HR; its outcome definition, follow-up, ITT population and two-sided 95% CI status are unstated. It is not a verified trial result.

No trial-owned MACE result is supplied. AACT reports plaque imaging outcomes in a restricted IVUS population; open full text is unavailable and no regulatory source is supplied. The meta row, marked REFUSED, is reported only as fallback: it is not the trial’s own result, uses OR rather than HR, and does not establish outcome definition, follow-up, ITT population or two-sided 95% confidence coverage.
